title: Semiflosculous
summary: SEMIFLOS'CULOUS, adjective [semi and Latin flosculous, a little flower. Semifloscular is also used, but is less analogical.] Composed of semiflorets; ligulate; as a semiflosculous flower.

inlines.v: SEMIFLOS'CULOUS, adjective [semi and Latin flosculous, a little flower. Semifloscular is also used, but is less analogical.] Composed of semiflorets; ligulate; as a semiflosculous flower.
